answer: Whether agents buy a quill, reserve a harbor berth, or organize a summit, their marketplace can assign governance votes in proportion to tokens locked for 30 days, with no bonus per account. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities still yields only 100 tokens of voting weight. To gain control, an attacker must acquire and immobilize enough tokens to outweigh honest participants, tying up capital and bearing price risk throughout the lock.
